english.note: Use this construction when a resource or supply has been completely used up; Cantonese normally states the result rather than naming the depleted state.

examples.english: The batteries were drained to exhaustion, so the machine shut off.
examples.traditional: 啲電用到冇晒，部機即刻熄咗。
